Question ID: ANP_U01_L07_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.HLR.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Health, Environment, Heredity, and Disease Contexts
Stimulus: Medical case data

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify the health claim. Then use the required stimulus (Medical case data) to connect the visible evidence to health evidence, heredity, environment, and disease context. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.HLR.01 and avoids the common mistake: assuming one factor fully causes every health outcome.
